text: This is the boiler room. It is the only warm room I have, and you are the first visitor it has had who did not come to mend it.
That is a gas burner. Its flame is four metres long, and it is four metres long however you bend it. A portal does not give it a fresh start. Nothing in here gets a fresh start.
The big flame spends two of its four metres getting to its own panel. There is a burner in here that wastes less. It is not lit. Fire lights fire.
Light the small burner with the big one, and send the small one's flame instead. Of the two high panels, only one is near enough to the strap. And the ash pit has a white floor for a reason.
You have set fire to my boiler room with my own boiler. I would be cross, but it is the first thing in here to work properly in years.
You have lit the pilot light. It went out the day the engineer left. He said he would be right back.
That was fire. It is the oldest test there is, and everybody fails it the same way.
You walked into the flame. It was four metres long and bright orange. I do not know what more it could have done.
Burnt. I will open a window. I have no windows. I will think about a window.
The flame was not chasing you. It was standing still. You did all of the work.
